prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized colony settlement marker. Flat app-icon geometry. Three
conical spires of decreasing height on a simple rectangular base
block — center spire tallest, two flanking spires shorter. Each spire
is a flat saturated palette color, the base a contrasting palette
color. Small flat rectangular "window" shapes on the base in a
secondary palette color.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding, bold vector geometry readable at 16px. A stylized settlement colony marker: three conical spires rising from a solid rectangular base block — center spire tallest in vivid red (#FF0000), left spire medium height in vivid blue (#0000FF), right spire shortest in vivid yellow (#FFFF00) — each spire a sharp flat triangle with crisp edges. The rectangular base rendered in vivid green (#00CC00), with two small flat rectangular window shapes in pure white as secondary detail. All fills bold and saturated, zero gradients, zero texture, zero brushwork. Strong color separation between every element. Perfectly centered composition, clean modern UI icon register, every silhouette edge deliberate and precise, fully legible at small sizes.
